text.plain: This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air. While wearing it, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Elementals and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You know Auran, have Resistance to Lightning damage, and have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover. Its Elemental Compulsion has save DC 18. The ring has 5 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn, and casts its printed air spells at save DC 18.
